title: Headline Kyushu cell: mean and dispersion under both fold designs
why: \SOTA and \SOTAweekly were exempt from the guard as literature values from Lago et al. They are this project's own Kyushu M1/XGB+weather results, so the exemption rested on a false premise and left two printed numbers unchecked
reading: the daily-rolling design gives a higher mean MAE than the weekly anchor on the same cell; the supplement's table reports both, and neither is a literature benchmark
